about_the_game:
The ChipWits Original Game Soundtrack is a vibrant homage to the quirky charm of a sunglass-wearing, roller-skating robot! Complete with computer keyboard percussion, typewriter synths, bass clarinet and jazzy piano that create a soundscape that's as inventive as the game itself!

Celebrating the 40th anniversary of the classic 1984 programming game, this soundtrack infuses fresh robotic energy with catchy melodies and driving drum beats. It's a musical journey through the whimsical world of robot programming, where you become the programmer!

Music composed by Jared Farney.

Both MP3 and WAV versions available.
